limitations: Finite synthetic suite; not exhaustive over all possible inputs.
Baseline parity does not establish mathematical accuracy of either kernel.
Write guards do not prove absence of reads; read safety is statically derived for exact tested geometry.
Unmodified input post-images are checked by the audited driver after each arm but not retained separately; corrupted images would have been retained.
Admission is sampled and excludes known process names, not all conceivable hidden GPU consumers.
No timing/model performance or promotion claim; subsequent timing requires separately reviewed bounded driver and parent admission.
semantic_replay.raw_files_count_scope: 572 files in the two GPU subtrees, including their summaries

actual_audit.campaign_reason: Core median savings below frozen12percent on both devices and both regimes; all-componentPASS does not qualify model performance.
limitations: Synthetic shapes and unknown real target frequencies; no PP/TG extrapolation.
NegativeKcontrol has a small measured slowdown within predeclared tolerance, not zero regression.
99percent bootstrap interval is a fixed serial-sample screen, not model confidence.
Read safety is static for fixed geometry; write canaries do not prove absence of reads.
Unmodified input postimages were checked by reviewed driver but not individually persisted.
Process and idle admission are observational, not proof against arbitrary hidden consumers.

thresholds.eligible_each_shape_each_device_each_reg: median saved >=5%; paired deterministic bootstrap99% lower >=2%; relative MAD both <=3%; even/odd order difference <=3%; every batch>=0.1ms; at least one positive calibration; max calibration<=5%minimum batch

plan.stop: Any semantic failure aborts. Any timing gate failure stops candidate advancement after one bounded screen. No automatic retry or selective rerun.
plan.context: >1% PP would need approximately9.15%downbucket improvement under prior coverage assumption; actual target coverage unknown. No kernel threshold proves model benefit.
plan.component_gate: The5%gate is isolated component evidence only, insufficient for campaign qualification.
plan.campaign_priority_heuristic: Only if all component gates pass AND core/full_grouped each show>=12%median savings and>=10%99%bootstrap lower on both devices and both regimes: REVIEW_REAL_COVERAGE_PRIORITY_ONLY. Otherwise PARK_NO_MODEL_QUALIFICATION. No automatic coverage/model test. Prior9.15%downbucket context is optimistic prioritization, not a rigorous wall-time bound.
plan.timer_validity: Every raw batch >=0.1ms; at least one positive finite empty-event calibration; maximum raw calibration <=5% minimum batch duration. All16 calibration values preserved including zeros. No subtraction/adaptation/retry. These are conservative empirical timing-validity gates, not a hardware timer-resolution assertion.
